verdict.rationale: Alloy's own API reference is publicly browsable and hosted on ReadMe. It spans 134 endpoint pages and runs a "Try It!" request panel with SDK snippets, so examples execute live against the sandbox or production bases. Sandbox mode lets those calls run without vendor charges. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the Try It panel works; runnable examples without customer-gated account keys; sandbox isolation (it is a per-request mode only, with no data boundary).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The ReadMe-hosted API reference (134 endpoint pages, publicly browsable) runs the "Try It!" request panel with SDK snippets enabled
execution uses the caller's own keys against the live sandbox/production bases
